summary: Columns that run one prompt on several models at once, so a person can read the answers side by side and keep the best one. Each column shows its model, the answer as it streams in, the time it took and what it cost. When the answers settle, the fastest time and the lowest cost are highlighted.
use: When people choose which model an agent or feature should use.
When you want to compare quality, speed and cost on the same prompt.
In a prompt playground or evaluation tool where someone picks a winning answer.
features: Up to `max` columns (3 by default), each with a model picker; columns can be removed and new ones added from "Add a model".
One prompt box sends to every column through `onSend`; Send is disabled while a full send is still running.
Each column follows its answer's `state`: a thinking indicator, then words fading in as `text` grows, then the finished answer.
Shows `seconds` and `cost` once done, with tokens per second in the time's tooltip, and marks the fastest and cheapest column.
Changing a column's model, or adding one after a prompt was sent, calls `onRun` for just that column.
"Use this" sets `chosen`; the chosen column is outlined and the others fade.
a11y: Each model picker is a role="menu" whose items are role="menuitemradio" with aria-checked on the current model.
The picker buttons expose aria-expanded and aria-haspopup, and Escape closes an open picker and returns focus to its button.

From the keyboard, Enter, Space or the down arrow opens a menu with the focus on its picked item, or its first (the up arrow, on its last); the arrow keys move through it and wrap, Home and End jump to the ends, Tab closes it and moves on, and closing it gives the focus back to its button.
The prompt input and the send and remove buttons have aria-labels.
The prompt is a form, so Enter sends it.

faq.q: How do I stream each model's answer into its column?
faq.a: Handle `onSend`, call your models, and update `answers` keyed by column id. Set `state` to 'thinking', then 'answering' with growing `text`, then 'done' with `seconds`, `cost` and optionally `tokensPerSecond`.

faq.q: What happens when someone swaps the model in one column?
faq.a: The column keeps its `id`, the pick is cleared, and `onRun` is called with that column if a prompt has already been sent. Rerun just that column and update its answer.

faq.q: How do I know which answer the person kept?
faq.a: Listen to `onChosenChange`. It gets the chosen column's id, or null when they unpick it or send a new prompt.

faq.q: Can I compare more than three models?
faq.a: Yes. Set `max` to the number of columns you want; "Add a model" shows until that many are open.
